llm.summary: This real-money trading skill mostly matches its stated purpose, but it needs review because some account actions and live-run safety controls are under-scoped.

dimensions.detail: SIMMER_API_KEY use and outbound calls to Simmer, Polymarket, and Binance are coherent with automated trading. The optional WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY is declared in metadata, but the reviewed first-party code only reads SIMMER_API_KEY.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation requires simmer-sdk with an unpinned lower-bound dependency and setup guidance uses an unpinned pip install, so a future SDK version would receive the trading API credential without being the reviewed artifact.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Paper mode is the default and live mode is explicit, but the documented every-minute live cron workflow lacks a process lock or transactional budget reservation, so overlapping runs can exceed the intended daily trading limit.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The manifest has autostart false and cron null, but SKILL.md recommends a persistent crontab live run every minute and the code writes daily_spend.json plus .last_auto_redeem state files. This is purpose-aligned state, but recurring live execution needs stronger safeguards.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The code implements the stated fast-market momentum strategy, including market discovery, signal gating, sizing, spread checks, and trade submission. Material concerns remain because it also performs auto-redeem and GTC order cancellation, and SKILL.md still says 'validated magnitude filter' despite repeated no-edge and retraction language.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only after reviewing the live-trading risks. Use a dedicated low-balance Simmer account or wallet, start in paper mode, pin the SDK version before production use, avoid exposing WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY unless strictly required, and do not run the provided cron live workflow without a lock or other single-instance control.
llm.findings:
[TP4] unexpected: Not accepted as stated: artifact/fast_scaler.py contains the core gate, sizing, market discovery, and trade-execution logic; the unit test file only covers one helper.
[LP3] expected: Partly accepted: environment, file, and network access are expected for this trading skill, but the artifacts do not define a tight permissions boundary for a high-impact financial workflow.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Accepted: the 'validated magnitude filter' use-case line conflicts with nearby retraction and no-measured-edge language, which can mislead live-trading users.
[SQP-3] unexpected: Accepted for the same contradiction: the artifact should not imply validation or performance quality while saying the actionable signal has no measured edge.
[RA2] expected: Accepted with context: cron is user-visible rather than hidden, but persistent every-minute live trading is high impact and should be installed only with explicit operator intent and locking.
[SDI-1] expected: Partly accepted: configurable asset, window, and gate values are visible in code and some docs warn they are untested, but SKILL.md overstates BTC 5m and 0.10 percent as if they were stricter invariants.
[SDI-2] expected: Accepted as under-disclosed: auto-redeem is account-management behavior adjacent to trading, but it is not clearly described in the main skill instructions or manifest.
[SQP-2] expected: Downgraded: SIMMER_API_KEY consumption is disclosed in setup and metadata, though live mode users should still treat it as a financial credential.
[T09] unexpected: Accepted: the daily budget file is read and written without an inter-process lock around the trade decision, so overlapping live cron runs can overspend the intended daily cap.
[T08] unexpected: Accepted: simmer-sdk is not pinned to an exact reviewed version even though it receives credentials and performs trading, cancellation, redemption, and account queries.
